verdict.rationale: The Department of State publishes turnaround commitments only for its paid expedited tiers (24 hours, same day, 2 hours) on the certificate of incorporation page. Nothing in the evidence shows current or live processing times, or standard non-expedited times, for the transaction. Missing for 10: published current/standard processing times for non-expedited filings, per-transaction-type current backlog figures, an online versus paper processing-time breakdown, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: $25.00 per document for processing within 24 hours, $75.00 per document for processing within the same day, or $150.00 per document for processing within 2 hours.
Expedited Filing — The Division of Corporations offers optional expedited processing of documents
